GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

4. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   B. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Industry as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   C. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

13. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   B. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.
   D. Treat Energy as rumours only.

15. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

16. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
